pr_body:
Backport 1/1 commits from #118589.

/cc @cockroachdb/release

Release justification: Bug fix for a bug that leads to job system unavailability. 

---

The CREATE AUTO STATS code was manually modifying the system.jobs table in a way that left the job_info table with abandoned rows.

Fixes #118582

Release note (bug fix): AUTO CREATE STATS jobs could previously lead to growth in an internal system table resulting in slower job-system related queries.

issue_context.title: sql,jobs: AUTO CREATE STATS jobs cleanup can abandon job_info rows
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**


The AUTO CREATE STATS jobs has code to detect concurrent creation of a status job for a given table and exit with an error to avoid having duplicate stats jobs. Unfortunately, that code then deletes the job from the system.jobs table in an effort to avoid confusing error messages going to the user:

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/cc4fdffa8532d16544c48ef036689763f737dc6b/pkg/sql/create_stats.go#L160-L170

This code fails to clean up the related system.job_info rows.  Those rows will never be cleaned up because our job-gc maintenance routine only cleans up jobs that are listed in the jobs table.

In a large cluster with many tables, this can result in a very large job_info table, slowing down jobs related queries substantially.


Jira issue: CRDB-35798
